label: TagI system
definition: A type IV modification-dependent restriction system in which an organism possesses a TagI-family locus encoding an SRA-HNH restriction endonuclease that recognizes 5-methylcytosine- or 5-hydroxymethylcytosine-modified DNA.
observations: TagI branch under type IV modification-dependent restriction system; distinct from McrA, VcaM4I, EcoKMcrA, McrBC, GmrSD, MspJI, PvuRts1I, ScoMcrA, broad RM_Type_IV and Other_Type_IV source keys, individual TagI proteins, individual SRA or HNH domains, TagI nuclease activity outside a complete organism-level Type IV restriction system, individual 5mC/5hmC DNA substrates, and the DefenseFinder TagI source key outside a complete organism-level system.
